name: Huangshan Novel Co.,Ltd
summary: Huangshan Novel Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells packaging materials in China and internationally. The company offers flexible packaging for food and beverages, daily chemical, pet's products, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications; PE, CPP, BOPP, metallized, multi-layer co-extruded, and coated films, as well as CPP and PS sheets. It also provides gravure universal ink, dedicated gravure ink for OPP, gravure surface print ink, and flexo printing ink; and injection molding for flexible packaging. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Huangshan City, China.
